arguments.sql_query:
WITH ppi_ingredients AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE concept_id IN (19039926,904453,43009052,929887,923645,948078,911735)
),
ppi_desc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  JOIN ppi_ingredients pi ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = pi.concept_id
),
ppi_exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN ppi_desc p ON p.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
),
index_ppi AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM ppi_exposures
  GROUP BY person_id
),
new_ppi AS (
  SELECT i.person_id, i.index_date
  FROM index_ppi i
  JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id = i.person_id
    AND i.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date
    AND op.observation_period_start_date <= DATEADD(day, -365, i.index_date)
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM ppi_exposures p2
    WHERE p2.person_id = i.person_id
      AND p2.drug_exposure_start_date >= DATEADD(day, -365, i.index_date)

WITH ppi_ingredients AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE concept_id IN (19039926,904453,43009052,929887,923645,948078,911735)
),
ppi_desc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
  JOIN ppi_ingredients pi ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = pi.concept_id
),
ppi_exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN ppi_desc p ON p.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
),
index_ppi AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM ppi_exposures
  GROUP BY person_id
),
new_ppi AS (
  SELECT i.person_id, i.index_date
  FROM index_ppi i
  JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id = i.person_id
    AND i.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date
    AND op.observation_period_start_date <= DATEADD(day, -365, i.index_date)
),
mag_measured AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT n.person_id
  FROM new_ppi n
  JOIN omop.measurement m ON m.person_id = n.person_id
    AND m.measurement_date >= n.index_date
    AND m.measurement_date < DATEADD(day, 91, n.index_date)
  WHERE m.measurement_concept_id IN (3001420,3042811)
    AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL
    AND (m.unit_concept_id = 8840 OR lower(m.unit_source_value) IN ('mg/dl','mg/dl.','mg per dl'))
),
low_mag AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT n.person_id
  FROM new_ppi n
  JOIN omop.measurement m ON m.person_id = n.person_id
    AND m.measurement_date >= n.index_date
    AND m.measurement_date < DATEADD(day, 91, n.index_date)
  WHERE m.measurement_concept_id IN (3001420,3042811)
    AND m.value_as_number < 1.6
    AND (m.unit_concept_id = 8840 OR lower(m.unit_source_value) IN ('mg/dl','mg/dl.','mg per dl'))
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT n.person_id) AS new_ppi_users,
       COUNT(DISTINCT mm.person_id) AS users_with_magnesium_recorded_within_90d,
       COUNT(DISTINCT lm.person_id) AS users_with_magnesium_lt_1_6_within_90d,
       CAST(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT lm.person_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT n.person_id), 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS pct_of_new_ppi_users,
       CAST(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT lm.person_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT mm.person_id), 0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS pct_of_tested_users
FROM new_ppi n
LEFT JOIN mag_measured mm ON mm.person_id = n.person_id
LEFT JOIN low_mag lm ON lm.person_id = n.person_id
